items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1974-01-01
items.q: And they said, no, they want to be with me. If they couldn't be with me, they didn't want to back home.

ctx.x: That was the problem. So finally, after you get the amount that you want. It was lucky enough that there were enough automobiles to leave. In those days, everybody didn't have an automobile like today. Orpidermy with his model T-fold and playing Jack Ebert with his Dodge and Don Alvigotis Chrysler. That's a convertible.
I know you didn't understand about Richard McCarty and Richard Johnson. What happened there after the job was taken?

Yeah, they didn't want to place them with the family band, the Peripets. And they said, no, they want to be with me. If they couldn't be with me, they didn't want to back home. And they went back? So they went back to New Orleans.
